test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: If, 'A # B' means 'A is the mother of B', 'A - B' means 'A is the daughter of B', 'A @ B' means 'A is the brother of B', 'A $ B' means 'A is the father of B', then how is F related to P in the expression 'F # T @ G $ H - K # P'?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/226a478965ea5a297428f28d2aa97c5569b7f846696762092b8b6d0a99f231f3.png] 

The given expression is:

**F # T @ G $ H - K # P ⇒ **F is the mother of T, T is the brother of G, G is the father of H, H is the daughter of K, and K is the mother of P.

F is the mother of T,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfd8dfa0976b0ff888c2dad5f5501e7da637db3df2a2fbea2230576e5d48e154.png] 

T is the brother of G

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c1eb26ec7c192eee70bb5bd2948801e7b08d6d536352b7980829cc8611bf539.png] 

G is the father of H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa6bdc1f8d873b5bc53746b441fb989fa7fecd8a42712eca4523e8f01ac8fb81.png] 

H is the daughter of K

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/819a13e0c1af6312fb369b6e15363d7b661cadfc704b7a0da28016ed0307acb2.png] 

K is the mother of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a846099e96cbb47cace89942aacfc1f8e26780d465b4a870436e4a3f5d4fe341.png] 

Therefore, F will be P's father's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 3**".
